description: This source file defines the `MediaIDHelper` utility class, providing methods to create, parse, and manipulate media ID strings used in a media browsing application. It helps in maintaining the hierarchy and categorization of media items.

classes.name: MediaIDHelper
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and parsing media identifiers used within the media browsing framework.

methods.name: createMediaID
methods.description: Constructs a media ID string from a music ID and optional categories, using separators to encode hierarchy.

methods.name: createBrowseCategoryMediaID
methods.description: Creates a media ID for a specific browse category given its type and value.

methods.name: extractMusicIDFromMediaID
methods.description: Extracts the unique music ID from a media ID string.

methods.name: getHierarchy
methods.description: Splits a media ID into its hierarchical components, excluding the leaf music ID.

methods.name: extractBrowseCategoryValueFromMediaID
methods.description: Retrieves the category value from a media ID representing a browse category.

methods.name: getParentMediaID
methods.description: Determines the parent media ID in the hierarchy for a given media ID.
